title: Team worlds, cleaner saves, trading by name
intro: A round of fixes from a three-player playtest. Teams keep each world they played, and every save starts the story where it left off.
notes: Teams keep their worlds apart: the leader picks which one to play on the team screen, or starts a new one.
Iosefka's door and the dog are no longer briefly undone when you load a different save.
Every guest gets their own player number, so levers and doors answer the right hunter.
A wipe while you are alone keeps the kills you made with the team.
Busy connections send far fewer repeat packets.
No damage number floats over a downed hunter's body.
Trading lists a "Give to" row for each partner by name.

info.title: First time here
info.text: Open Co-op, point it at your Bloodborne folder and type the host's IP. The host types their own address and PLAY starts the server for them.

info.title: Make a team
info.text: Press Continue, Load Game or New Game: the team screen opens. Invite hunters online, ready up, and the leader begins the hunt.

info.title: In the game
info.text: Insert or L3 + R3 opens the port's menu: graphics, controls and the Co-op Team page, where you can invite or remove players.
